mechanism: Moxifloxacin may potentiate the antihypertensive effects of irbesartan, and fluoroquinolones can rarely cause QT prolongation which may be additive with irbesartan's potential cardiac effects in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function periodically; use cautiously in patients with baseline QT prolongation or electrolyte abnormalities; ensure adequate hydration during moxifloxacin therapy.
